title: Tapping LATAM's Untapped Patient Pool for Ophthalmology Trials
body_markdown:
As competition for patients increases and sponsors look for more efficient, diverse and scalable approaches to clinical research, Latin America (LATAM) is becoming an increasingly important region for ophthalmology trials.


Watch this on-demand webinar to learn how LATAM's healthcare landscape, patient populations and growing research infrastructure can help accelerate ophthalmology studies while expanding access to clinical research.


### Featured speakers:


- Tanya Richardson, Therapeutic Strategy Head, Ophthalmology and Neuroscience, Fortrea
- Teresa Barros, Senior Clinical Research Associate, Fortrea
- Patricio Schlottmann, MD, Ophthalmologist and Retina Specialist, Charles Research Center
- Leandro Reis Tavares, Executive Vice President, Rede D’Or São Luiz & IDOR
